evals.prompt: Create a Flow Launcher plugin in TypeScript named DevDocs Quick. The action keyword is dd. When the user types dd react, show 5 mock documentation results from a local array. Pressing Enter should open the result URL. Include a SettingsTemplate.yaml file that lets users choose Compact or Detailed mode and set the maximum number of results.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript Flow Launcher plugin scaffold with plugin.json, package/build setup, JSON-RPC query dispatcher, settings template, result actions, and local smoke-test guidance.

evals.prompt: My current Flow Launcher Node.js plugin sometimes returns no results because debug text from console.log is mixed into stdout. Fix main.js so the JSON-RPC output is always valid, route logs to stderr, and add a Node.js smoke test command using a query payload.
evals.expected_output: A focused bug fix that preserves the existing project, keeps stdout JSON-only, routes diagnostics to stderr, handles errors as Flow-visible results or stderr, and documents/runs a smoke test.

evals.prompt: Prepare a JavaScript Flow Launcher plugin for release to the Plugin Store. Create a GitHub Actions workflow that zips the plugin with node_modules, reads Version from plugin.json, and create a Flow.Launcher.PluginsManifest entry with UrlDownload, UrlSourceCode, and a CDN IcoPath.
evals.expected_output: Release workflow and store manifest changes that follow Flow Launcher Node.js docs, include runtime dependencies in the zip, tag releases from plugin.json Version, and identify URL/icon placeholders needing real repository values.
